title: Titanium Chamber Liner (Upper)
system: Plasma Chamber Liners, Shields & Thermal Hardware
function: Upper chamber wall protective plasma liner
alloyReason: Bead-blasted Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is chosen for Titanium Chamber Liner (Upper) where controlled surface roughness (Ra 3.2-6.3 µm) improves adhesion of applied coatings or bonding agents. The 345 MPa yield with 30% elongation provides sufficient ductility for forming operations while maintaining the excellent corrosion resistance characteristic of CP titanium. This surface preparation is tailored for Upper chamber wall protective plasma liner. This rationale is driven by upper chamber wall protective plasma liner and specific design requirements.
process: Cleanroom CNC Class 100 for chamber shield geometry
UHP DI water cascade rinse with 0.5mm corner radius
Particle count MIL-STD-1246 with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Electropolishing Ra <0.25um + UHP DI cascade rinse with particle count verification per MIL-STD-1246 Class 1 — tailored for upper chamber wall application
commonFailures: Metal particle shedding >1e10 at/cm2 - eliminated by UHP VAR+ESR double-melt + electropolished ID — critical for upper chamber wall performance

faq.q: What outgassing properties does Titanium Chamber Liner (Upper) have in vacuum environments?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti exhibits outgassing rates below 1×10⁻¹² Torr·L/s·cm² after bake-out at 200°C for 4 hours, compliant with SEMI F3 and ASTM E595 requirements. Total mass loss (TML) <0.1% and collected volatile condensable materials (CVCM) <0.01% per ASTM E595. This makes Titanium Chamber Liner (Upper) suitable for upper chamber wall in UHV processing chambers down to 1×10⁻¹⁰ Torr.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Chamber Liner (Upper) orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Chamber Liner (Upper) is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Chamber Liner (Upper)?
faq.a: Each Titanium Chamber Liner (Upper) shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for upper chamber wall.
